cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant harbour city known for the Sydney Opera House, the Harbour Bridge and Bondi Beach.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Australia's cultural capital, famous for laneway cafés, street art, live music and sport.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A megacity where neon-lit Shibuya meets quiet shrines, with Mount Fuji visible on clear days.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Japan's old imperial capital, with around 1,600 temples, wooden townhouses and spring cherry blossom.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Home of the Christ the Redeemer statue, Sugarloaf Mountain and the world-famous Carnival.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: Brazil's largest city, a hub of food, art and nightlife along the busy Avenida Paulista.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The world's largest religious monument, built in the 12th century. Best seen at sunrise over its reflecting pools.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: A white-marble mausoleum in Agra completed in the 17th century and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

temples.name: Borobudur, Indonesia
temples.description: The world's largest Buddhist temple, a 9th-century monument with over 500 Buddha statues near Yogyakarta.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A turquoise lagoon ringed by coral reef, famous for overwater bungalows below Mount Otemanu.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: A 4 km crescent of sand in Rio de Janeiro, lined by its iconic wave-patterned promenade.

beaches.name: Railay Beach, Thailand
beaches.description: Reachable only by boat and framed by limestone cliffs that draw rock climbers from around the world.
